Traveling with Pets at Aurelia Skyways

The Companion Animal Travel Desk helps you prepare a smooth trip with an animal in cabin or in the cargo area. The team gives clear steps before departure and keeps the process calm and humane for everyone involved. If you are packing for a pet, start by checking size, age, and crate details before you leave for the airport.

A rabbit and its crate together must weigh no more than 18 kg. Keep the crate sturdy, secure, and easy to handle, and make sure your animal has enough room to stand and turn without stress. Good preparation makes check-in faster and keeps your pet more comfortable during the journey.

A bird must be at least 15 weeks old before travel. Bring the right travel documents, follow the packing instructions, and allow extra time for review at the desk. If your plans change, tell the airline early so the team can adjust the booking and avoid problems at departure.

Travelers like Aya Johnson, Talia Moretti, and Finn can all count on straightforward guidance from the desk. The staff answers questions in a warm, professional way and focuses on safe care from check-in to handoff.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
